title: Our strapline
slide_intent: Teach how a short invitation can move a reader from recognition toward participation. A second imperative makes the intended outcome part of the same phrase.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give different campaigns one compact verbal sign-off that joins an audience invitation to the organization’s purpose.
demonstration: The strapline occupies a large clear pink field. A white hand-drawn underline emphasizes its ending.
practical_value: Use the two imperatives together when a piece needs a concise sign-off or call to participate.

content_islands.spec: Set the complete line in heavy black type across the open field. Underline the final phrase with the white gesture.
